scale_cues: A large stainless steel mixing bowl fills most of the frame (rim about 28–30 cm across). I compared the chicken cubes and olives (each olive about 2–2.5 cm long) with the bowl's diameter. Next to the bowl is the dish-scale platform.
assumptions: The pale cubes are skinless chicken breast. They could be thigh or turkey, but they look like white meat.
The dark purple oval items are Kalamata olives. USDA SR has no exact Kalamata entry, so I used brined olives. Ripe canned olives are another option.
I counted about 40 chicken pieces at roughly 2–3 g each.
I can't see any sauce or dressing. Any cooking oil is small and already counted in the roasted chicken entry, so I didn't list it separately.
The chicken is only in a thin layer, so there is little risk of pieces hidden underneath.
